events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot dead in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas on this day in 1996, aged 25.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the life and legacy of Tupac Shakur today, 30 years since his untimely passing. His impact on hip-hop and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Honouring the incredible Jimi Hendrix, who we lost on this day in 1970. His revolutionary guitar work continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles delivered the masterpiece that is 'Abbey Road'. What's your go-to track from this legendary album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the iconic Liam Gallagher – still bringing the swagger and the tunes. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal album 'Imagine' on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace that resonates just as powerfully today.

events.title: First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? It's 25 years since Apple changed the game for portable music. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the release date of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate 007 movie moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend, John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years of 'The White Album'! The Beatles' ambitious double LP dropped on this day in '68. Which track stands out most for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Queen frontman and rock icon Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991, aged 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who we lost on this day in 1991. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Classic
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game! A pivotal album that pushed boundaries. What's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: The world mourned on this day in 1980 as John Lennon was tragically shot and killed in New York City, aged 40.

angles.name: John Lennon Remembered
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. Always remembered.
